displayName: HDR, reflections and VRC Light Volumes
author: Vixen Creations
description: Fixes a divide-by-zero in the normal reconstruction and a mirrored reflection vector, stops emission clamping at 2.0, and adds box-projected probe blending, fresnel and VRC Light Volumes.
notes: Needs the free VRC Light Volumes package.
Set Corrected Reflection Vector to 0 to keep the original reflection direction.
Set Fresnel to 0 to keep the original flat reflection response.

tokens.name: LIGHT_VOLUMES_INCLUDE
tokens.installHint: Install VRC Light Volumes (red.sim.lightvolumes) from the VRChat Creator Companion or https://github.com/REDSIM/VRCLightVolumes

operations.note: Give centre emission an HDR colour picker
Give edge emission an HDR colour picker

operations.text:
_Smoothness ("Smoothness", Range(0,1)) = 1
		_FresnelStrength ("Fresnel", Range(0,1)) = 1
		_FresnelBase ("Fresnel Base Reflectivity", Range(0,1)) = 0.15
		[ToggleUI] _CorrectedReflection ("Corrected Reflection Vector", Float) = 1
		[ToggleUI] _WorldPosFromDepth ("World Position From Depth", Float) = 1
		[ToggleUI] _UseLightVolumes ("VRC Light Volumes", Float) = 1
		_LightVolumeIntensity ("Light Volume Intensity", Range(0,2)) = 1
		_LightVolumeSpecular ("Light Volume Specular", Range(0,2)) = 1
